item.title: Albania's Protests Pile Pressure on Edi Rama
item.description:
Albania's violent anti-government protests follow months of demonstrations against a luxury development deal with Jared Kushner.
Gresa Kraja explains the link to Donald Trump's son-in-law. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Lithium Miner PLS Markets $700 Million Bond in Expansion Push
item.description: PLS Group Ltd is returning to the US dollar bond market, braving a junk-debt selloff as the Australian lithium miner lines up investments to expand production.

item.title: Carney Spent Oil Windfall on Tax Write-off, Budget Watchdog Says
item.description: Canada’s budget watchdog says new federal measures, including a major tax incentive for businesses, have more than offset a surge in revenues driven largely by higher energy prices.

item.title: Starboard Value CEO Jeff Smith Lays Out Case for Three New Bets
item.description: Starboard Value Chief Executive Officer Jeff Smith laid out the activist fund’s approach to its three latest investments at the annual 13D Monitor Active-Passive Investor Summit in New York today.

item.title: Canadian Dollar Hits Nearly One-Month High After Alberta Vote
item.description: The Canadian dollar posted its best day in roughly four weeks and outperformed most of its Group-of-10 peers after voters in the province of Alberta rejected the idea of separating from Canada.

item.title: Wells Fargo Indicator Flashes Buy Signal After Stock Turbulence
item.description: Wells Fargo & Co.’s sentiment indicator is giving a “buy” signal for the first time since June 2025, suggesting that US stocks have fallen to attractive levels after a slide fueled by worries over artificial intelligence and elevated oil prices.

item.title: Da MPB ao sertanejo, a música se divide politicamente
item.description: Barbara Nascimento conta como a divisão na música reflete a disputa política no país. Edição de Patricia Xavier. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Brokers Gear Up for Compute Futures Ahead of Regulatory Approval
item.description: Some top commodity brokerage firms are gearing up for what is promising to be the next front for AI trading: the buying and selling of derivatives tied to the cost of renting computing power used to develop and run artificial intelligence.

item.title: Vestel Offers 45% Haircut or Six-Year Extension on 2029 Bonds
item.description: Beleaguered Turkish white-goods maker Vestel Elektronik is asking holders of its 2029 bonds to back a restructuring under which they can choose to take a 45% haircut or extend the debt by six years.

item.title: US Economy's Resilience is 'Coming at a Cost,' Says Frances Donald
item.description: Treasuries are set to keep falling out of favor as an equity hedge amid a return to a persistently elevated inflation regime. Frances Donald, Chief Economist at RBC, breaks down this elevated inflation regime and what it means for wages, the labor market, and US economy as a whole. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: JPMorgan Asset Sees Bitcoin Beating Stocks, But With a Catch
item.description: JPMorgan Asset Management has included Bitcoin in its long-term capital market assumptions for the first time, forecasting returns that could beat stocks, bonds and gold in a milestone for its Wall Street acceptance.

item.title: NYC Girls Private School Chapin Cuts Debt After Campus Expansion
item.description: An all-girls private school on New York’s Upper East Side attended by Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis tapped the municipal bond market to refinance some of the debt it’s taken on to expand its campus.

item.title: Odd Lots: Are Financial Regulations Falling Apart?
item.description: From hot dog eating contests to political prop bets, CME CEO Terry Duffy tells Joe Weisenthal and Tracy Alloway why unchecked prediction markets risk violating federal manipulation standards. They spoke on the Odd Lots podcast, recorded live at Chicago's City Winery. Listen wherever you get your podcasts. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: US Eyes India’s Reliance to Refine Venezuelan Oil
item.description: The US is looking to persuade India’s Reliance Industries Ltd. to refine more Venezuelan crude as Washington seeks to bring additional supplies to a market rattled by the Iran conflict.

item.title: Bessent Sees No Spillover From France Bond Market’s Turmoil
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said he doesn’t anticipate a spillover from the French bond market, which has seen surging yields that have in turn driven a broader conversation about the European nation’s finances.

item.title: S&P 500 Rebounds as Big Bank Stocks Climb, SpaceX Results Loom
item.description: The S&P 500 Index rose, erasing its early-session losses, as big banks and healthcare companies climbed. The tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 Index rebounded to a slight gain after South Korean neocloud company Elice Inc. tanked in its trading debut, spurring concern about the sustainability of the global AI boom that continued to weigh on the sector.

item.title: Gold Wavers as Traders Weigh US-Iran Talks, Fed Rate Path
item.description: Gold wavered as traders assessed the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path and the status of negotiations to end the war in Iran.

item.title: Stocks Rise as US-Iran Hopes Trigger Oil Decline: Markets Wrap
item.description: Wall Street traders drove stocks and bonds higher as oil prices dropped on hopes for a diplomatic way to the end the war in Iran.

item.title: Trump Accounts, Bonds Barometer, ‘Dividend Nomads’
item.description: "Bloomberg ETF IQ" focuses on the opportunities, risks and current trends tied to the trillions of dollars in the global exchange traded funds industry. Today's guests: TD Head of ETF Sales & Strategy Andres Rincon, State Street Head of Research Strategists Matthew Bartolini, T. Rowe Price Head of Digital Assets Strategy Blue Macellari, and TMX VettaFI Head of Research Todd Rosenbluth. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Autocallable ETFs Give You Buffer, Yield: Rincon
item.description: Andres Rincon, head of ETF sales & strategy at TD Securities, joins Isabelle Lee and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss autocallable ETFs and new sports performance ETF filings. (Source: Bloomberg)
